info.description:
Laboratory Activity 3 (RESTful API Design Standards) - tests for every /api/v1 endpoint of the BulldogEx Shop API.

1. Start the server first: npm run dev (inside marzan-server).
2. Send the requests from top to bottom. Saved values (token, userId, categoryId, supplierId, hoodieId, ...) are stored in the collection variables, so do not skip requests.
3. Requests marked [Validation] are supposed to fail; their tests pass when the API returns the expected error status.

Folder 8 deletes the temporary category, supplier, and product created by this collection.

pm.test("Error message mentions: Category not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Category not found"));
